claim: Every one of the four published rho=21 bichromatic matching-cover witnesses is satisfiable as a signed-K4 extension CNF, so selected-support incidence, cross-color intersection, bichromatic degree, and absence of a K5 forced by selected supports do not imply an extension obstruction.
variable_convention: x_v=1 means the prospective vertex-edge to v is red; a selected red K4 gives the clause OR_{v in R} not x_v and a selected blue K4 gives OR_{v in B} x_v.
scope: This exactly refutes sufficiency of the published finite witness systems as extension obstructions. It neither proves that every matching-cover solution is satisfiable nor refutes the hypothetical existence of a different 44-clause minimally unsatisfiable signed-K4 system.
